ddl.value: "code_ready" = 0 OR ("code_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "code_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: guest_invitation_code_ready

ddl.value: "status" != 'pending' OR ("issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "expires_at" > "issued_at")
ddl.name: guest_invitation_pending_dates

ddl.value: ("status" = 'accepted' AND "accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" != 'accepted' AND "accepted_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: guest_invitation_acceptance

ddl.value: ("status" = 'revoked' AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" != 'revoked' AND "revoked_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: guest_invitation_revocation

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'node' AND "route" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'lan' AND "route" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: guest_resources_route

ddl.value: length("ports") BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND "ports" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9,-]*'
ddl.name: guest_resources_ports

ddl.value: "state" != 'active' OR ("headscale_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "permission" IS NOT NULL AND "activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "expires_at" > "activated_at")
ddl.name: guest_vpn_active_dates

ddl.value: ("requested_duration_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "requested_duration_seconds" IN (43200, 86400, 172800, 604800)) OR ("requested_duration_seconds" IS NULL AND "requested_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: guests_requested_duration

ddl.value: ("status" = 'draft' AND "revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'revoked' AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: guests_revocation
